item.description:
MetalFlight 0.1.9 Beta 8 is an app update for the Preview channel.
### Honeycomb flight controls
Connect the Alpha yoke and Bravo throttle before pressing **Play**. MetalFlight now configures Wine to use raw HID for Honeycomb devices, which helps the simulator see their individual axes and buttons. MetalFlight refreshes its Windows environment the first time it applies the setting. If Steam was already running and you previously configured Honeycomb support by hand, close the simulator, choose **Stop everything**, then press **Play** again. Use **Controllers… → Check Wine** to check each device.
The new setting loaded in an isolated Wine prefix. Physical Alpha, Bravo and Charlie input in MSFS still needs confirmation. See [issue #12](https://github.com/AndreaCodinLife/metalflight/issues/12).
### Microsoft security-key prompt
**Sign-in help** beside **Play** explains how to locate a prompt hidden behind the simulator. MSFS keeps its window above other windows, which prevents MetalFlight from reliably bringing the prompt forward. Press **Control–Up Arrow** to open Mission Control and look for the prompt. If the simulator is full screen, check the desktop in the Spaces bar. To switch methods, click **Cancel** in the security-key prompt, then select another available method on Microsoft's sign-in screen.
The help was verified in the packaged app. The live Microsoft security-key flow still needs confirmation. See [issue #11](https://github.com/AndreaCodinLife/metalflight/issues/11).
### Installation
Select **Preview** under **Settings → Updates**, then choose **Check for Application Updates…**. For a manual install, extract the ZIP and move the app to Applications. The app is ad-hoc signed and has no Apple notarization. The full interactive updater transition remains unverified.
App and runtime updates are separate. Beta 8 uses the same runtime as Beta 7, `2026.11.12-dev12-preview2-d3dmetal1`. If you already have it installed, the app update is sufficient. Mullion is the default renderer. The experimental D3DMetal option and the existing startup and flight limitations carry forward from [Beta 7](https://github.com/AndreaCodinLife/metalflight/releases/tag/v0.1.9-beta.7).
